page.overview:
What is Dino Island?

Dino Island, also known as Adventurers Dino Island, is the third sub-theme in the Adventurers series.

It is the second smallest Adventurers sub-theme, with only Jungle being smaller. All sets were released in 2000, and out of all fourteen sets, only four had more than 100 pieces.

The Adventurers discover the uncharted Dino Island, where living dinosaurs can still be found. The returning (and newly renamed) main villain Sam Sinister seeks to capture the dinosaurs and profit off of them by opening a theme park, so Johnny Thunder and the heroes must protect the dinosaurs and thwart the evil hunters.

Continue your adventures with Johnny Thunder and his crew. They've just discovered a secret island where Dinosaurs are alive! Help Johnny and the other adventurers study and protect these Prehistoric creatures, but watch out for Baron von Baron and his evil accomplices, who are trying to steal the dinosaurs and take them into captivity!
